implement_Task_subclass: implement a new Task subclass that overrides prepare, step_task, evaluate_fitness, and close methods
override_prepare_method: override the prepare method to set up the task environment and return initial state
override_step_task_method: override the step_task method to process an action and return the new state and outcome
override_evaluate_fitness_method: override the evaluate_fitness method to evaluate a solution and return a score or success status
override_close_method: override the close method to clean up resources and shut down the task environment
